name: Omaspaces
author: Daniel Lobo
description: Configurable Hyprland workspace indicators with clickable per-window app icons, workspace names, scratchpad pills, and workspace profiles that relaunch your app layout.

barWidget.description: Workspace pills with clickable per-app icons. Right-click an icon to move or close its window, right-click a number to rename the workspace, and use the profiles button to save and restore app layouts.

schema.label: Show app icons
schema.description: Render a glyph for each open window's app inside its workspace pill.

schema.label: Show workspace numbers
schema.description: Show the workspace number. Turned off, an icon-only pill still falls back to numbers when app icons are also off.

schema.label: Base workspace count
schema.description: Workspaces always shown, even when empty.

schema.label: Highest workspace shown
schema.description: Workspaces above the base count are shown only up to this id, and only once they have a window.

schema.label: Hide empty extra workspaces
schema.description: Beyond the base count, drop workspaces entirely once their last window closes instead of leaving a dimmed placeholder.

schema.label: Max icons per workspace
schema.description: Caps how many app icons a single pill draws before collapsing the rest into a +N count.

schema.label: Active color
schema.description: Palette role used to tint the active-workspace highlight.

schema.label: Compact spacing
schema.description: Tighten padding and gaps between pills.

schema.label: Show window titles on hover
schema.description: Hovering a workspace pill lists the titles of its open windows.

schema.label: Custom icon rules file
schema.description: Path to a JSON file of [{"match": "regex", "icon": "glyph"}, ...] rules, checked before the built-in icon list. Right-click any workspace pill to add rules through a UI instead of editing this file by hand. Supports ~ and $HOME. Reloads automatically when the file changes.

schema.label: Show special workspaces
schema.description: Add a pill for each special (scratchpad) workspace that holds windows; click it to show or hide that workspace.

schema.label: Show profiles button
schema.description: Show the button that opens workspace profiles: saved app layouts you can relaunch in one click.

schema.label: Workspace names
schema.description: Map of workspace id to a short name shown next to its number, e.g. {"1": "dev"}. Right-click a workspace number to edit it from the bar.

schema.label: Profiles file
schema.description: JSON file where workspace profiles are stored. Supports ~ and $HOME. Reloads automatically when the file changes.
